name: Performance
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the ultimate performer who accomplishes all things on behalf of His people, as affirmed in Psalms 57:2. Believers are called to trust in His faithful fulfillment of promises, exemplified by the performance of divine words spoken to Mary in Luke 1:45. This trust is illuminated by God's Word, which guides and directs like a lamp (Psalms 119:105), encouraging believers to let their good works shine before others to glorify God (Matthew 5:16). The joyful response to God's performance of His promises is expressed through praise and a merry heart, which brings spiritual and physical benefit (Psalms 149:1; Proverbs 17:22).
